file(TOUCH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/file1.txt)
file(TOUCH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/file2.txt)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dir1)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dir2)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/positions)
foreach(index RANGE 1 160)
  file(TOUCH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/positions/entry-${index})
endforeach()
string(REPEAT "x" 255 long_name)
file(TOUCH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/positions/${long_name})
